name: Nedbank Group Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | CRON 2026-10-12: H1 2026 column completed from Nedbank Group Limited unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial results for the 6 months ended 30 June 2026, JSE cloudlink ie2026.pdf, figures in R million. Printed condensed consolidated statement of comprehensive income: net interest income 22 021; non interest revenue and income 16 214; total net income before impairment charge on financial instruments 38 596; impairments charge on financial instruments 4 804; total net income 33 792; total operating expenses 21 696; profit before direct taxation 11 442; direct taxation 2 361; profit for the period 9 081. Operating Expenses is the printed total operating expenses. Profit Before Tax is the printed profit before direct taxation. Income Tax is the printed direct taxation. Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the issuer printed profit for the period of R9 081m; the stored Net Profit of R8 354m follows the issuer profit attributable to ordinary shareholders, which the file also carries for FY2025 at 7 799m, the difference being the additional tier 1 and preference share distributions the issuer prints separately. That relationship is the same in the existing annual columns, so it is recorded here rather than changed. Revenue 33 792, the printed total net income, and EPS 18.3, the printed basic earnings per share of 1 830 cents, were already stored and are unchanged. A bank presents no cost of sales, gross profit or EBIT line, so those cells stay empty.
